summary.en: Brighton beat Manchester City 1-0 at the Etihad Stadium on Saturday, with Yasin Ayari scoring the only goal in the 11th minute after pouncing on Matheus Nunes' miscued clearance. It was City's second straight Premier League defeat — their first back-to-back league losses since August 2025 — though Enzo Maresca's side stay top of the table. The win was Brighton's first ever at the Etihad; the Seagulls climb to third, two points behind City and Arsenal, who can go top with victory at Liverpool on Sunday.

summary.en: Freiburg came from behind to beat Augsburg 2-1 away in the Bundesliga on Saturday. Michael Gregoritsch gave the hosts an 18th-minute lead, but Igor Matanović equalised in the 65th minute before substitute Cherif Irié headed home the winner in the 85th. The victory lifts Freiburg to third in the table.

summary.en: Stuttgart thrashed Bayer Leverkusen 4-2 away in the Bundesliga on Saturday, handing the hosts their first home defeat of the season. Ermedin Demirović struck twice (14', 65'), with Jamie Leweling (22') and Bilal El Khannouss (51') also on target; Patrik Schick (28') and Massa (79') replied for Leverkusen.

summary.en: Rayo Vallecano swept Celta Vigo aside 3-0 at home in La Liga on Saturday. Jorge de Frutos scored twice (36', 55') before Unai López added a third in the 73rd minute, as Rayo kept a clean sheet in a dominant display.

summary.en: Hong Kong's Coleman Wong reached the final of the Seoul Challenger on Saturday, beating Australia's Omar Jasika 6-2, 7-5 in the semi-finals. Wong will face France's Térence Atmane in Sunday's final as he chases the title.
